invoice.what: A bill from a seller asking for payment, with items, amounts, tax and a total
invoice.not_for: A salary slip or a bank statement

salary_slip.what: A monthly pay slip from an employer showing earnings, deductions and net pay
salary_slip.not_for: An offer letter (that promises pay, it doesn't pay it)

bank_statement.what: A list of transactions on a bank account over a period, with a running balance
bank_statement.not_for: An invoice or a single receipt

offer_letter.what: A job offer from a company with role, start date and salary (CTC)

resume.what: A person's CV: experience, education and skills

rent_agreement.what: A contract between a landlord and a tenant for renting a property
rent_agreement.not_for: An invoice for rent (a bill, not a contract)

medical_bill.what: A bill from a hospital, clinic or pharmacy for treatment or medicines

insurance_policy.what: An insurance document: policy number, cover amount, premium and who is insured
